figures.finding: The only published pay floor in Wallis and Futuna is the territory's own guaranteed minimum wage (SMIG), set in its official journal (JOWF): XPF 575 an hour and XPF 97,250 a month from the third quarter of 2024 through the end of 2025; it applies to an employed performer as to any employee.

value.basis: SMIG of Wallis and Futuna (JOWF), general, not film-specific

figures.finding: Wallis is where most people in the territory live: 8,088 of its 11,151 residents in 2023, against 3,063 on Futuna; no source names a film centre or the main town.

value.basis: census population, not a production count

sources.said: En 2023, 11 151 personnes vivent à Wallis-et-Futuna, dont 8 088 personnes à Wallis et 3 063 à Futuna.

figures.finding: Mata'Utu, on Wallis, is the territory's chief town, and French, Wallisian and Futunian are the languages spoken, by IEOM's 2025 panorama; no source names where screen work is made.

value.basis: chief town, not a production count

figures.applies: Wallis and Futuna; IEOM panorama no. 425, January 2025.

sources.said: Chef-lieu du Territoire Mata'Utu … Langues parlées Français, Wallisien et Futunien
